Name: Starvalley Exchange - Futures Trading
Author: qiaodoumadai111
Description:
Late-game Stardew with more money than you can spend gets boring, doesn't it?

Welcome to the Starvalley Exchange. Get rich overnight — or lose it all by morning. Only two kinds of people survive at this table: the strong, and the careful. Trade like an idiot and it will kill you.

And no, you don't need to know a thing about futures. The mod ships with a full tutorial chain, plus an in-game Help page with five starter steps, a glossary and the usual beginner mistakes. Placing an order is three clicks: pick a contract, hit Buy Long or Buy Short, close it later. Never read a candlestick in your life? You can still take this market apart.

44 contracts, near and far months, margin, a market-maker order book, and 34 villagers trading against you. Losing everything won't kill you. Being laughed at is the price.


--------------------------------------------------
1. HOW TO PLAY
--------------------------------------------------

1. Press F8, open the Trade tab, pick a contract you actually recognise: pumpkin, blueberry, tuna, iridium.
2. Start at 1x leverage and a quarter of your lot size. The novice protection period gives you a liquidation buffer, so your first few trades won't one-shot you.
3. Think it goes up, hit Buy Long. Think it goes down, hit Buy Short.
4. Settlement runs at 6:00 every morning. Not enough margin and you get liquidated. Greedy? Add to the position. Smart? Take profit.
5. Before you open anything, look at your liquidation price on the Positions tab. When that number turns red, you're dying.

Eleven tabs: Market / Trade / Positions / Orders / Townsfolk / Leaderboard / Achievements / News / System / Profile / Help.


--------------------------------------------------
2. THE "TARGET GAP" COLUMN
  the beginner's crutch, and the official cheat
--------------------------------------------------

The rightmost column on the Market tab. Click the column header to switch it on.

With it on, every contract tells you two things: the target price the market is being pulled toward, and how far the current price is from it. Can't read a chart, can't judge direction? This one column is enough.

Which is exactly the problem. It is the answer written on the screen.

Three things it costs you, stated plainly:
- Turn it on and the guessing is gone. Every coin you make isn't yours, it's the column's.
- Villagers trade weighted by the same target price, so the market actually gets harder to beat.
- It shortens the mod's lifespan dramatically. Get rich on day one and there is nothing left to play.

Want the real thrill? Leave it off.
It is training wheels for a newcomer, not a retirement plan.

(Re-enabling it pops a hard confirmation dialog. That is not drama — it really does ruin the feel.)


--------------------------------------------------
3. WHAT'S INSIDE
--------------------------------------------------

MARKET
- 44 contracts: vegetables, forage, minerals, livestock, fish, timber
- Multi-month delivery (7 / 28 / 56 / 84 days), rollover, term structure, storage cost
- Market-maker order book, liquidity walls, price impact and slippage, intraday margin calls

ORDERS
- Market / limit / batch
- Stop-loss, per-position take-profit and stop-loss, forced liquidation
- Physical delivery, bankruptcy protection and revival
- Leverage unlocked by rank

PEOPLE
- 34 villagers plus 3 tycoons, all running their own books
- Villagers copy your trades and hand you commissions (locked-price purchase / consignment / copy-trade / intel verification)
- An intel market that sells you news, some of it true; attitudes and relationships shift
- A tutorial quest chain that walks you in

PROGRESSION
- XP and levels, ranks and privileges, margin rates that improve with rank
- Novice protection, behavioural achievements, seasonal settlement and titles, exchange terminal upgrades

INTERFACE
- 11 tabs on F8
- Daily settlement statement, Pelican Financial Daily, news ticker, portfolio risk, trade statistics


--------------------------------------------------
4. INSTALLATION
--------------------------------------------------

1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)
2. Drop the whole StarvalleyExchange folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Launch the game, press F8

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+.


--------------------------------------------------
5. COMPATIBILITY
--------------------------------------------------

- Stardew Valley Expanded supported. A few contracts (goose egg, butterfish, monster fruit) need SVE for physical delivery; trading works without it.
- No vanilla data is overwritten. The mod only appends its own letters to Data/Mail.
- No Harmony patches, no patching of vanilla methods, so it cannot fight another mod over code.
- Zero external textures, zero audio, so it cannot fight over assets either.
- Save data lives inside the save file. Uninstalling will not corrupt your save.

Known minor issue: the custom character "Victor Grey" uses the internal key Victor. If you also run SVE, friendship calls may land on SVE's Victor. Numbers only, no save damage.


--------------------------------------------------
6. LANGUAGE AND CONSOLE
--------------------------------------------------

Chinese and English text are included. On any other system language the interface falls back to Chinese.

Console commands:
sxe_help            help
sxe_status          account and market snapshot
sxe_money 100000    deposit gold into your futures account


--------------------------------------------------
7. CREDITS
--------------------------------------------------

Gameplay inspiration: Stardew Futures by ruralalan
(https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46801, MIT)

This mod's code is a clean-room rewrite. No source code, art assets or text from that project are included. Contracts, systems, interface and story characters are independently implemented.

Bug reports: please attach your SMAPI log from https://smapi.io/log
